page.title: Global Barcode Policy
page.description: Manage the single central barcode generation policy used by all WMS modules.
page.historyDescription: Immutable barcode issue history with policy version and scope.

scopeHelp.ProductSerial: Identifies individual stock instances by stock code and serial number.
scopeHelp.ProductLot: Identifies lot-tracked stock by stock code and lot number.
scopeHelp.Logistics: Identifies pallets, parcels and logistics units.
scopeHelp.Document: Identifies receipt, transfer, shipment and other operation documents.

form.name: Profile name
form.segmentsHelp: Reorder segments with the arrows. Every profile must contain exactly one sequence segment.

messages.previewed: Barcode preview created without consuming a sequence.
messages.concurrency: The profile was changed by another user; the page was refreshed.

required.required: Barcode generation is blocked when the value is empty.
required.optional: When the value is empty, this segment is omitted from the barcode.

sequence.summary: A unique {{length}}-digit sequence number is generated atomically.
sequence.effect: Each real generation reserves the next value only once. Preview does not consume a sequence; the same idempotency key does not generate another value.
sequence.scenario: If the next value is 765, {{value}} is generated using {{length}} digits.
sequence.warning: The sequence segment guarantees profile uniqueness and therefore cannot be removed.

date.summary: The generation date is appended to the barcode in {{format}} format.
date.scenario: 8 August 2026 is converted to {{format}} format and written.

literal.summary: The fixed text ?{{value}}? is written identically in every barcode.
literal.effect: The fixed value is added to the pattern {{transform}}. {{requiredText}}
literal.scenario: If the fixed value is SERI, every barcode from this profile contains the SERI segment.
literal.warning: A barcode cannot be generated when a required fixed segment is empty.

field.summary: The {{source}} value is added to the barcode {{transform}}.
field.effect: {{source}} is read from the operation data. {{requiredText}}
field.warning: A barcode cannot be generated from this profile when {{source}} is missing.
